capabilities: Draws a letter badge as a Windows taskbar overlay icon
Uses the first letter of the vault name by default
Lets you set the letter, background color and letter size
disambiguation: Not a badge on notes, tabs or files; it only changes the Windows taskbar button icon.
extras: Windows only; overlay icons are not supported on other platforms, and pop-out windows do not get a badge.
problem: Vault windows on the Windows taskbar look alike, so users cannot quickly see which window belongs to which vault.
summary: Draws a one-letter badge as a Windows taskbar overlay icon so different Obsidian vaults can be told apart.
